base_intake.interpretation: Canonical base intake is the preserved broad discovery baseline and is not treated as a historical completeness proof.

supplemental_gap_fill.assessment: All four material first-party release/access gaps identified by v0.1 were collected successfully and verified to enter canonical Screening normalization. No unresolved gap requires an Exception Gate.

within_year_temporal_skew_audit.assessment: No catastrophic calendar interval hole is visible. Every month contains more than 2,500 unique arXiv papers; Q4 is densest and Q1 sparsest. Remaining completeness risk comes from capped query slices and surviving publisher indexes rather than an empty period.

arxiv_cap_audit.assessment: Six cs.LG month slices hit the configured result ceiling. Exact-identity checks protect material selected anchors, but the broad intake cannot establish historical absence or a complete census.

anchors: Learning to Summarize from Human Feedback

screening_boundary.note: Coverage observations not promoted by Screening remain preserved in Raw/base intake. The Pile is retained as a year-boundary raw observation but was not promoted into the 2020 Evidence set.

residual_limitations: Present-day official index snapshots cannot prove that every 2020 publisher item remains linked or byte-identical to its original publication state.
Six capped cs.LG month slices may omit non-headline research; exact checks protect material editorial anchors but do not make the research intake exhaustive.

The configured GitHub Release watchlist targets projects material mainly in later years and yields no normalized 2020 release records; commit-level ecosystem history is not reconstructed exhaustively.

Some first-party pages have moved or been edited since 2020; supplemental capture establishes recoverable publisher-defined release/access boundaries, not independent reproduction of capability claims.
Representative bias/toxicity benchmarks establish an evaluation trajectory without claiming an exhaustive 2020 safety-evaluation census.

single_volume_assessment.rationale: Scaling, model access, retrieval, dialogue, systems scaling, generative-media branching, feedback steering and evaluation/risk form interacting year-scale trajectories with a coherent handoff into 2021. No Evidence-backed need for an H1/H2 split is visible.
